idea-plugin.name: MobTimer Keymap Switcher
idea-plugin.description:
Enables automatic keymap switching when integrated with the MobTimer macOS application.

This plugin runs a local HTTP server on port 8765 that accepts keymap switching commands from MobTimer when driver rotation occurs.

Features:
  • Automatic keymap switching on driver rotation
  • REST API for keymap control
  • Support for all installed IntelliJ keymaps
